question.prompt: The difference between a \(6.5\%\) sales tax and a \(6\%\) sales tax on an item priced at \(\$20\) before tax is

solutions.explanation:
Both taxes are calculated from the same \(\$20\) price, so their difference is \(6.5\%-6\%=0.5\%\) of that price. Since \(0.5\%=0.005\), the difference is
\[
20\cdot0.005=0.10.
\]
Thus the difference is \(\boxed{\$0.10}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
solutions.title: Use the difference in tax rates
